differently.line: But each lover's steps fall so differently
stanza: We swore we'd travel, darlin', side by side
We'd help each other stay in stride
But each lover's steps fall so differently
But I'll wait for you. And if I should fall behind, wait for me

differently.songTitle: Put Your Hand In The Hand
differently.line: Take a look at yourself, and you can look at others differently
stanza: Put your hand in the hand of the man who stilled the water
Put your hand in the hand of the man who calmed the sea
Take a look at yourself, and you can look at others differently
Put your hand in the hand of the man from Galilee
